# Peta Konsep Anak Bangsa

> > An Indonesian educational initiative promoting concept mapping and visual thinking methodologies for students and educators through free training, resources, and community engagement.

Peta Konsep Anak Bangsa (PKAB) is a concept mapping education project founded by Suryadi that provides mind mapping training, educational packages, and consulting services primarily for Indonesian schools. The initiative combines visual thinking techniques with learning methodologies to enhance educational outcomes across elementary and higher education institutions.

## Key Topics

- Concept Mapping (Peta Konsep)
- Mind Mapping
- Visual Thinking
- Tony Buzan
- Indonesian Education
- Learning Methodologies
- Distance Learning

- 5W1H Framework

- Brainstorming

## Core Organization

- [Homepage](https://pkab.wordpress.com): Main hub for Peta Konsep Anak Bangsa concept mapping educational initiative
- [Vision & Mission](https://pkab.wordpress.com/visi-misi): Vision and mission statement guiding PKAB's concept mapping education goals
- [About](https://pkab.wordpress.com/about): Organization background and founder Suryadi's vision for concept mapping in education

## Services & Offerings

- [Services](https://pkab.wordpress.com/layanan): Professional offerings including brainstorming, consulting, and mind mapping training programs
- [PKAB Educational Package](https://pkab.wordpress.com/isi-paket-pkab): Complete educational package contents designed for elementary school distribution and implementation
- [Distribution Call](https://pkab.wordpress.com/sebarkan): Project announcement and initiative to spread PKAB concept mapping programs to schools

## Learning Resources & Tutorials

- [Tutorial: Creating Concept Maps with Mind42](https://pkab.wordpress.com/2009/05/05/tutorial-membuat-peta-konsep-dengan-mind42): Step-by-step guide for creating concept maps using the Mind42 digital tool
- [SWOT plus 5W1H Framework](https://pkab.wordpress.com/2011/07/11/swot-plus-5w-1h): Methodology combining SWOT analysis with 5W1H questioning framework using mind maps
- [Mata Kuliah Peta Konsep 101](https://pkab.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/mata-kuliah-peta-konsep-101-kelas-001-telah-dibuka): Free online course announcement for Peta Konsep 101 class available on Piazza platform

## Community & Partnerships

- [Sponsorship & Donors](https://pkab.wordpress.com/sponsor): Listing of corporate sponsors and CSR contributors supporting PKAB initiatives
- [Tony Buzan Endorsement](https://pkab.wordpress.com/2013/10/07/en%c2%b7cour%c2%b7age%c2%b7ment): Celebration of mind mapping pioneer Tony Buzan's endorsement of PKAB educational initiative
- [BiNus University Freshmen Program](https://pkab.wordpress.com/2011/08/04/freshmen-enrichment-program-mind-map): Large-scale mind mapping training program for BiNus University tutors and students

## Support & Information

- [FAQ](https://pkab.wordpress.com/faq): Frequently asked questions on mind mapping history, Tony Buzan, and concept mapping techniques

- [Visual Thinking in Business](https://pkab.wordpress.com/2009/11/05/the-value-of-visual-thinking-in-social-business): Presentation exploring the strategic value of visual thinking methodologies in business contexts
